question: Under what impure condition can one still effectively remember the goddess?
premises: The condition is having an ucchiṣṭa mouth.
The action is remembering the goddess.
The remembrance can occur at any time.
inference: Remembrance of the goddess remains valid even in a state of ucchiṣṭa impurity.
plain_english: If, with an ucchiṣṭa mouth, one should ever remember the goddess...
